work.summary: Digital MAXQ Secret B photobook featuring Korean fitness influencer Jeong Hanna (정한나). Aladin's Secret B series catalogue lists the exact Vol. 11 title as a PDF e-book from 2022-08; Sports Seoul reports the Secret B No. 11 shoot and names Jeong Hanna, while Maeil Business calls her a fitness influencer. Page count and ISBN were not verified. No cover image or paid PDF was copied because reuse permission is unconfirmed.
